title: Audit Admin flashcard styles screen and APIs

spec.problem: Admin flashcard style screen and six API contracts need end-to-end audit against canonical profile/style persistence and admin protections.

acceptance.text: Audit GET/POST /api/admin/flashcards/styles, GET adoption analytics, GET/PATCH /api/admin/flashcards/styles/{id}, POST /api/admin/flashcards/styles/{id}/transition individually; fix local contract defects with tests. Test /admin/:locale/flashcards/styles anonymous and authorized states, primary UI interactions, 390x844 rendering, console/network, and persistence. Record verdicts and next item in durable reports; commit the screen before the next screen.

Audit six style METHOD+PATH contracts separately; validate profile-based adoption counting with PostgreSQL; verify CRUD/status validation, audit evidence, auth/CSRF; test Admin styles screen anonymous and authorized in headed 390x844; remove disposable fixtures before commit.
A signed-in Admin without admin.content.read/write is denied on all six style routes; denied mutations leave the fixture unchanged.
Create and patch flashcard styles reject missing or invalid theme config without persisting it.
A valid mixed-case-gradient theme can be created, patched, and transitioned, with domain data and audit rows committed.
A failed audit insert rolls back its flashcard style mutation.

spec.expected_behavior: Style adoption counts are derived from profile.user_profile.flashcard_style_slug; all six method/path contracts validate and persist safely; UI supports authorized use at mobile viewport.
spec.observed_behavior: The adoption handler joins reading_user_preference.user_id to flashcard_style.id, while ReadingUserPreference has no style field and UserProfile stores flashcard_style_slug.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert only the AUDIT-126 code commit; fixture rows are disposable and removed by tests/browser cleanup. No schema/data migration is planned.
